description.zh:
设备ID类型，支持：

- device_id：硬件ID，
- sn：序列号，
- vin：车架号，
- hardware_id：硬件ID
description.en:
The device ID type. Valid values:

- device_id: hardware ID
- sn: serial number
- vin: vehicle identification number
- hardware_id: hardware ID.

description.zh: 设备ID列表，英文逗号隔开。具体设备ID使用哪个，由DeviceIdType决定。
description.en: The list of device IDs, separated by commas (,). The type of device ID used is determined by DeviceIdType.

description.zh:
版本类型，支持：

- FOTA：系统升级
- APP：应用升级
description.en:
The version type. Valid values:

- FOTA: system upgrade
- APP: application upgrade.

title.zh: 为系统版本或者应用版本添加黑名单
title.en: Add devices to the blacklist for a system version or application version

descriptions.zh: > 在系统升级或应用升级时，当希望某些特定的设备不允许升级时，可以调用此接口添加版本的设备黑名单。
descriptions.en: > During a system upgrade or application upgrade, if you want to prevent specific devices from being upgraded, call this operation to add devices to the version blacklist.
